db_evidence.notes: episodes:30sec:002058 / episodes:3min:000343 (61740-61770/61740-61920) and semantic_triples:0001011 (61770s) both explicitly name 绣花针 (embroidery needle) as equipped, with a 已装备 (equipped) indicator, immediately preceding the title-card/fight sequence for the boss (62190-62490, multi-legged/spider-humanoid enemy). The DB also contains a semantically similar but temporally distant distractor: topic_facts around 13260s describing a different multi-eyed/spider-bodied boss whose talisman panel shows an unrelated spell name 碧石化形, and whose visually-verified item name (via rollout-03's misdirected clip_qa) reads 碧尘. Both fights share generic descriptive vocabulary ('multi-legged', 'many eyes', 'spider-like'), making semantic_search alone ambiguous between them; only the temporal window (clue_interval 61767-62472) disambiguates which is the Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord fight.

root_causes: rollout-03 (score 0) found the correct evidence early via semantic_search but abandoned it after a later semantic_search query returned a semantically-similar distractor scene from a different, much earlier boss fight (13260s) with generic overlapping vocabulary ('multiple eyes', 'spider-like/multi-legged')

rollout-03 then anchored all follow-up SQL and its final clip_qa verification on the distractor's time window (13000-13500s / 50400-51600s) instead of cross-checking against the question's implied fight and never re-queried the 61600-62500s window it had already seen contain the correct evidence

the underlying DB text is unambiguous and correctly places 绣花针 at the equip event directly preceding the correct boss fight; the failure is a retrieval/reasoning selection error (choosing the wrong candidate interval to verify), not missing evidence
what_worked: anchoring run_sql on the time window given/implied by earlier episode hits (61600-63050s) rather than relying solely on semantic_search ranking, as rollouts 0/1/2 did, directly surfaces the unambiguous equip-screen text

when a distractor is initially picked, a follow-up semantic_search with a more specific compound query (rollout-04: '绣花针 百眼魔君' combining the suspected item name with the boss name) can redirect the agent back to the correct interval

visual verification (clip_qa) confirms but does not by itself select the correct interval; it only reinforces whatever hypothesis interval was passed to it, so an early wrong interval choice propagates through clip_qa unchanged
transferable_lessons: when multiple candidate boss/entity fights match a generic description (e.g. 'multi-legged', 'many eyes'), do not commit to a clip_qa verification window until it has been cross-checked against the specific named boss/entity or against a temporally-anchored SQL scan; verifying the wrong interval yields a confident but wrong answer

do not discard an earlier semantic_search hit that already contains the literal target term (e.g. 绣花针 with 已装备) in favor of a later, more 'on-topic-sounding' but unverified hit; when two candidate intervals conflict, run SQL scoped to each interval before choosing which to visually verify
clip_qa answers are only as good as the interval passed to it — the sub-agent has no way to know it is looking at the wrong fight, so interval selection responsibility stays with the calling agent
